title: Ableton Session Writer
idiom: two-colour risograph print, a roll of punched paper laid in a silent player piano
hero_prompt: Two-colour risograph print in teal and orange on warm paper, grainy overprinted flat colour, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible ink grain and paper texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: an upright player piano in an empty evening room with its keyboard lid closed and a wide roll of paper already fitted behind its music desk, the roll's holes forming long patterned rows of round dots; the long ribbon of paper has been unspooled and lies in a loose curve across the floor, rows of round punched holes running along it; a wooden stool is drawn up to the piano, and a lamp sheds a small circle of warm light. The room is silent and ready, nobody present. Generous empty space.
icon_prompt: Risograph emblem, a flat single-colour teal silhouette on an orange ground, no shading or gradients: a round paper spool with a ribbon curling off it, the ribbon punched with a row of bold round holes. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
